list.question: How long is the installation process for a Bio Septic Tank?
list.answer: Our Bio Septic Tank installation is quick and convenient. It typically takes only 1 to 2 working days, depending on soil conditions and installation site.

list.question: Are the fiberglass tank products under warranty?
list.answer: Yes. All our fiberglass tank products (IPAL, STP, Bio Septic Tank) come with a leak warranty of up to 10 years, securing your long-term sanitation investment.

list.question: Is the treated wastewater from IPAL safe to discharge into sewers?
list.answer: Very safe. Our IPAL and STP systems use anaerobic & aerobic bio-filtration technology to break down waste, producing odorless treated water that meets government discharge standards.

list.question: Does the Bio Septic Tank require periodic pumping or emptying?
list.answer: No. The biological system inside the tank breaks down waste into liquid automatically. You no longer need to call toilet pumping services like with conventional concrete septic tanks.

list.question: Can Sinar Mahira design custom STP systems for hotels?
list.answer: Yes. We have an experienced engineering team to design and build custom capacity Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) systems tailored to your hotel's operational needs and site availability.
